DRUNKENMASTER-TAVERN_RAG.title: Tavern Rag
DRUNKENMASTER-TAVERN_RAG.description: At the start of combat, add [blue]{Ingredients}[/blue] random [gold]Ingredient[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].\nUpon pickup, gain [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] potion slots.
DRUNKENMASTER-TAVERN_RAG.flavor: It has never once been washed. That's the secret.
DRUNKENMASTER-TAVERN_APRON.title: Tavern Apron
DRUNKENMASTER-TAVERN_APRON.description: At the start of combat, add [blue]{Ingredients}[/blue] random [gold]Ingredients[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].\nYou have [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] extra potion slots.
DRUNKENMASTER-TAVERN_APRON.flavor: Washed exactly once, for the occasion.
DRUNKENMASTER-BANDOLIER.title: Bandolier
DRUNKENMASTER-BANDOLIER.description: At the start of combat, if at least half of your potion slots are full, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
DRUNKENMASTER-BANDOLIER.flavor: A bottle for every occasion, and an occasion for every bottle.
DRUNKENMASTER-MUDDLER.title: Muddler
DRUNKENMASTER-MUDDLER.description: Whenever you play an [gold]Ingredient[/gold], deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
DRUNKENMASTER-MUDDLER.flavor: Crush the mint. Crush the lime. Crush whatever's in front of you.
DRUNKENMASTER-HIP_FLASK.title: Hip Flask
DRUNKENMASTER-HIP_FLASK.flavor: A little something for the road. Every road.
DRUNKENMASTER-ABSINTHE_SPOON.title: Absinthe Spoon
DRUNKENMASTER-ABSINTHE_SPOON.flavor: The green fairy sends her regards.
DRUNKENMASTER-CHAMPIONS_TANKARD.title: Champion's Tankard
DRUNKENMASTER-CHAMPIONS_TANKARD.descript: While [gold]Tipsy[/gold] or [gold]Drunk[/gold], you have [blue]{Bonus}[/blue] additional [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
DRUNKENMASTER-CHAMPIONS_TANKARD.flavor: First prize, three years running. Nobody remembers the contest.
DRUNKENMASTER-COPPER_KETTLE.title: Copper Kettle
DRUNKENMASTER-COPPER_KETTLE.flavor: Bigger pot, bigger problems, bigger potions.
DRUNKENMASTER-BEER_BELLY.title: Beer Belly
DRUNKENMASTER-BEER_BELLY.description: Whenever you drink a potion, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
